root_cause: The autoComplete component lacks an Enter key handler to select the currently highlighted suggestion. The navigation controller handles arrow key navigation but there is no keydown listener for Enter to invoke the onSelection callback with the highlighted item's value.
repair_strategy: Add a keydown event listener in the init() method that triggers when Enter is pressed while the suggestion list is open (aria-expanded=true). The handler retrieves the element referenced by aria-activedescendant, obtains its text value, calls the onSelection callback, closes the list, and prevents default form submission.
expected_accessibility_effect: Ensures that pressing Enter selects the currently highlighted suggestion in the combobox, providing keyboard operability and conforming to WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and 2.4.3 Focus Order.
functional_risks: Possible duplicate selection if navigationController already handles Enter key
May interfere with custom onSelection expectations if they rely on mouse clicks only
Potential side effects if closeAllLists is not defined in scope (but it is imported)
verification_requirements: After typing 'bl' and pressing Down to highlight Blackberry, pressing Enter sets the input value to 'Blackberry'
The suggestion list closes after Enter selection
ArrowUp/Down navigation and Escape to close list continue to work as before
